retrieved.title: 资料退化：磁带与扫描线

request:
镜头 s21：纪录片中引用的旧资料影像，时长 8 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-arch58）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['ENG broadcast camera', 'scan lines']）：Locked look "2058 broadcast news archive" (style preset sp01-arch58): a shoulder-mounted 2/3-inch ENG broadcast camera; broadcast tape, later dubbed; an 18x broadcast zoom at auto iris; filter none; grade: hot clipped whites, crushed murky shadows, chroma smear on reds; light: floodlights, emergency strobes and whatever is there; texture: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, compression noise, an occasional tape dropout; urgent news footage of a disaster operation, the operator running with the crew.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：archival footage quoted inside a documentary
导演意图（自然语言）：潜水头盔摄像机画面，水下，黑暗，浑浊。头灯的光柱照着淹没的服务器机柜，一只戴手套的手伸向接口面板，用力插上。对讲机里传来宋工失真的声音。环境声：沉闷的呼吸声、气泡声、对讲机电流声。
情绪：claustrophobic, tense, heroic
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：point-of-view helmet camera, floating unsteadily underwater
景深与虚实：Murky water haze, only the panel and the glove sharp in the lamp beam.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Archival helmet-camera frame underwater in the flooded root-server hall: dark murky water, beams of helmet lamps cutting through silt between submerged server racks, a gloved hand reaching for a connector panel. Blocking lock: the submerged server rack fills frame right, the connector panel at frame centre, the gloved hand enters from frame lower left; helmet lamp beams sweep from the top.
Picture 2: Engineer Song at 43 (2058, the restart operation) (character reference; role: the protagonist). The same man ten years later, 43: the same face, mole and thin round steel-rimmed glasses, now grey at the temples, short stubble, a thinner face with deeper lines and tired eyes. Dark olive engineering field jacket with reflective strips over a black thermal undersuit.
Picture 3: the staging area of the 2058 root-server restart operation (location reference; role: location reference). A staging area at the edge of a flooded underground root-server facility in 2058: floodlights on tripods glaring off black water that covers the floor, concrete pillars, coils of cable, open equipment cases, diving helmets and air tanks on a tarp, a temporary railing at the water's edge. Empty of people, urgent, cold.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Song (a man in his forties, voice distorted through a diving-helmet radio, breathing hard) — 宋工（四十多岁男性的声音，从潜水头盔对讲机里传出，失真、喘着气）: 最后一组。我来。
现场环境声：heavy breathing in a helmet, bubbles, crackling radio static
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[ours/sound-underwater] 声音：水下与头盔
[rules/lens/documentary-zoom] lens
[rules/sound/underwater] sound
[ours/pace-doc] 节奏：纪录片的呼吸
[ours/arch-vhs] 资料退化：磁带与扫描线
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

The palette is crushed black-green with hot clipped white in the lamp cores; no readable text, numbers or logos. Blocking lock: the submerged server rack fills frame right, the connector panel at frame centre, the gloved hand enters from frame lower left; helmet lamp beams sweep from the top.
<Subject 2> is Engineer Song at 43 (2058, the restart operation) from <Picture 2>, serving as the protagonist and the diver whose helmet camera we see through. Male, 43. The same face and mole, thin round steel-rimmed glasses, grey at the temples, short stubble, a thinner face with deeper lines and tired eyes. Costume lock for this shot: dark olive engineering field jacket with reflective strips over a black thermal undersuit, plus the diving helmet and air tank from the staging area; only his gloved hand and sleeve enter frame.
<Subject 3> is the staging area of the 2058 root-server restart operation from <Picture 3>, serving as location and equipment reference. A staging area at the edge of a flooded underground root-server facility in 2058: floodlights on tripods glaring off black water that covers the floor, concrete pillars, coils of cable, open equipment cases, diving helmets and air tanks on a tarp, a temporary railing at the water's edge. Empty of people, urgent, cold. This is the world the diver has just entered; the shot itself stays underwater at the submerged racks.

summary:
